sb_prompt: FIND OUT WHAT THE OTHER CALLER THOUGHT ABOUT THE LAST FEW MOVIES THEY SAW. WHAT MOVIES HAVE YOU SEEN LATELY?
raw_output:
ParticipantA: What movies have you seen lately?
ParticipantB: I just saw a documentary about climate change.
ParticipantA: Yeah, I saw one about that too. It was really eye-opening.
ParticipantB: Yeah, it's crazy how much damage we're doing to the planet.
ParticipantA: Totally. I've been trying to live more sustainably ever since I saw it.
ParticipantB: Same here. I've been composting and using reusable bags.
ParticipantA: That's great. What was the last fictional movie you saw?
ParticipantB: I saw a thriller last weekend. It was pretty intense.
ParticipantA: Oh yeah? What was it about?
ParticipantB: It was about a detective trying to solve a serial killer case.
ParticipantA: Sounds interesting. I saw a rom-com last weekend. It was really cute.
ParticipantB: Oh, I love rom-coms. What was it about?
ParticipantA: It was about a woman who goes on a blind date and ends up going on a road trip with the guy she met.
ParticipantB: Sounds fun. I love road trip movies.
ParticipantA: Yeah, me too. What did you think of the documentary you saw?
ParticipantB: It was really well done. It made me realize how much we need to change our ways.
ParticipantA: Definitely. I felt the same way after seeing the one I saw. It's crazy how much waste we produce.
ParticipantB: Yeah, it's just not sustainable. We need to do better.
ParticipantA: Agree completely. Well, what's your favorite movie?
ParticipantB: That's a tough one. I really love The Shawshank Redemption.
ParticipantA: Oh, I love that movie too. The friendship between Red and Andy is so inspiring.
ParticipantB: Exactly. It's a classic. What about you?
ParticipantA: I have a few favorites, but one of them is The Godfather.
ParticipantB: Oh, I love that one too. Marlon Brando was amazing in it.
ParticipantA: Yeah, he was incredible. The movie has such an emotional impact.
ParticipantB: Definitely. Well, it was great talking to you.
ParticipantA: Yeah, you too. Thanks for chatting with me.
